m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You need a piece of stone for a table? Certainly! I chiseled this one from a cliff just this morning.
Here, let me help you squeeze it into your bag.
<ITALICS>It takes some work, but you get it in there. </ITALICS>
Huh. I had my doubts that would fit. Good luck with it!
Well done, Wizard! That huge stone slab is perfect for our task.
I can help you fashion a new table. We need a stone cutter of unequaled skill. You don't happen to know any Ettins, do you?
I've heard Billy Brute lives deep in the Weirwood. You'll have to find out where, the hard way, from the Handsome Fomori near Dun Dara.
Find the Handsome Fomori near Dun Dara and ask where the Ettin, Billy Brute, lives. The Fomori might make you work for it.
